items.title: EY survey reveals institutional private markets investors view illiquidity as top concern
items.summary: More than half of institutional investors in private markets point to illiquidity as a primary worry, according to EY data.

items.title: BT, Home Bargains, Marks & Spencer and Veolia join workplace savings coalition
items.summary: Four major employers have joined the National Coalition for Workplace Savings to help boost employee pension participation.

items.title: Lloyds Banking Group publishes practical guide on scaling artificial intelligence responsibly
items.summary: Lloyds Banking Group has released a new guide sharing lessons from its experience in scaling artificial intelligence and managing associated risks.

items.title: Car insurance inflation hits 8% as UK CPI rises to 3.6%
items.summary: Official figures show motor cover prices climbing at their fastest pace since mid-2024 as headline inflation edges upward.

items.title: DB schemes estimated to have £40bn buyout surplus, LCP says
items.summary: Private sector defined benefit pension schemes face important decisions as LCP estimates an aggregate buyout surplus of £40bn.

items.title: Mattioli Woods launches new fund range with JP Morgan and T Rowe Price
items.summary: Mattioli Woods has introduced a new range of investment funds in collaboration with JP Morgan Asset Management and T Rowe Price.
